label: How should animal groups be shown?

options.label: One card per group
options.why: Room for the hours bar and manure choices; one group at a time.

options.label: Compact table, expand a row to edit
options.why: Faster to scan when there are many groups.

label: How should the daily time budget be entered?

options.label: Hours per day (adds to 24)
options.why: People remember 'in at 6 pm, out at 6 am'.

options.label: Percent of the day (adds to 100)
options.why: Matches how the model stores it.

label: How should the feeding plan be entered?

options.label: Small grid with column totals
options.why: All animal groups visible at once.

options.label: One stacked bar per animal group
options.why: Friendlier when there are only a few feeds.

label: How should the farm location be picked?

options.label: Point on a map, values filled from maps
